title: 1998 AMC 8 Problem 14
statement: At Annville Junior High School, \(30\%\) of the students in the Math Club are in the Science Club, and \(80\%\) of the students in the Science Club are in the Math Club. There are \(15\) students in the Science Club. How many students are in the Math Club?

solutions.text:
Since \(80\%\) of the \(15\) Science Club students are also in the Math Club, the two clubs overlap in \(0.8\cdot 15=12\) students. This is \(30\%\) of the Math Club, so the Math Club has \(\dfrac{12}{0.3}=40\) students.

Thus, the correct answer is E .
hints: Find the number of students in both clubs first.
That overlap is \(30\%\) of the Math Club.
